summary: This bill permanently removes geographic restrictions and expands eligible locations for telehealth services covered under Medicare, allowing patients to receive care from home after the COVID-19 public health emergency.

scores.thoughts: This bill directly amends the Social Security Act to permanently remove geographic restrictions and expand originating sites for telehealth services under Medicare. This expands access to healthcare services, particularly for those who might otherwise face barriers to in-person care, thus pushing towards more public healthcare access.
